messages:
maria_gonzalez: Hey team, running into a JSON parse failure when using response_format={"type":"json","strict":true}. Started yesterday, intermittent. API returns a structured-output validation error. Request ID: req_01F7XH9Z. Posting minimal repro below — I get a 422 from the SDK even though the body looks like JSON. jen_support: Thanks for the report — can you paste the exact curl and the raw response headers+body? Also which model/variant and SDK version are you using? maria_gonzalez: Curl and raw response below (sanitized keys): ```bash curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","prompt":"Generate a JSON object","response_format":{"type":"json","strict":true}}' ``` Raw response (what the client received): HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

Note: This output may contain explanatory text.

{"status":"ok","data":{"id":"abc123","value":"hello"}}
Then the SDK returned: `Structured output validation failed: invalid JSON` (422). jen_support: OK that explains it — the service is returning text/html (HTML wrapper) even though the payload contains a JSON blob inside a 
. With strict mode enabled we verify Content-Type and the entire body must be valid JSON. Two quick questions: 1) is the behavior reproducible every time or intermittent for you? 2) can you confirm the model variant (any safety notes enabled)?

maria_gonzalez: It's intermittent: ~30% of requests fail. Model param I sent was `redwood-large-v1` (no explicit variant). SDK: js 2.1.4.

lee_engineering: Thanks — looks familiar. We pushed a model-side change last night to include short HTML safety notes for some completions when the safety sampler outputs a note. That accidentally wraps structured outputs in HTML for a subset of responses. Two things: 1) strict JSON enforcement in the runtime rejects non-application/json responses, and 2) some callers were relying on the JSON blob being extractable even when wrapped. This is a regression on our side.

eng-runtime-bot: Created issue INF-492: "sanitize html-wrapped structured outputs when response_format=json && strict=true" — https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-492 (assigned to @lee_engineering, ETA: 24h)

jen_support: For a short-term workaround you can either: 1) set `response_format.strict=false` (relaxes strict Content-Type/body check), or 2) set `response_format.type` to a loose mode if available, e.g. `{"type":"json_loose"}`, or 3) parse the inner JSON client-side by extracting the first `{...}` from the body (ugh, fragile). If you can tolerate strict=false for now that should unblock you.

maria_gonzalez: I tried setting strict=false and it worked (no 422). But we need strict validation for production. Any ETA on a permanent fix?

lee_engineering: We're rolling a patch to the runtime that will: detect HTML wrappers and strip them before structured validation, and also enforce Content-Type mapping for structured outputs. The immediate patch will sanitize responses that include a single JSON blob inside HTML or plain text notes. We expect rollout within ~24 hours, full verification in 48 hours.

lee_engineering: Temporary mitigation for platform operators — if you control a Dedicated or Private deployment you can enable the runtime flag `sanitize_html_wrapped_outputs=true` (will be in next private release). For hosted customers we'll push the sanitize step in front of validation.

sre_ankit: As an alternative short-term routing workaround you can try specifying `model: redwood-large-v1@no_notes` (we've published a variant with safety notes disabled for high-throughput structured output). That variant avoids the HTML note path. Let me know if you want me to pin a canary to your account.

maria_gonzalez: Thanks everyone — setting strict=false is an acceptable temporary unblock. Could you please keep me updated on INF-492? Also would appreciate a reproducible test case so we can validate once fixed.

jen_support: Absolutely — INF-492 will include a minimal repro (we captured the exact response that triggered the validator). I'll post the issue link and add you to the thread. In the meantime, if you can share the last failing request_id (req_01F7XH9Z) we'll attach logs and a HAR.

maria_gonzalez: Provided request_id above — thanks, attaching HAR to the support ticket now.

lee_engineering: Noted. We'll follow up in INF-492 with timeline and post-deploy smoke tests. Apologies for the regression — thanks for the quick repro info, that helped narrow root cause.

maria_gonzalez: Appreciate the fast response :heart:
